articles.summary: Northeast Bank Welcomes Blake Groves as VP, Commercial Deposit Relationship Manager bdomini@northe… Wed, 09/16/2026 - 08:19 Employee Portland, Maine, September 16, 2026 -- Northeast Bank (the “Bank”) is pleased to announce Blake Groves has joined the Bank as Vice President, Commercial Deposit Relationship Manager, based in the Bank’s Boston office. In this role, Groves will focus on developing and managing deposit relationships with current and prospective commercial real estate borrowers across the country. Groves brings more than 10 years of experience in relationship management and business development across banking and wealth management. Most recently, he served as Client Experience Coordinator at New Harbor Financial Group. Prior to that, he was Vice President, Private Client Relationship Manager at JPMorgan Chase in Boston, where he managed client relationships across banking, lending, and investment services. His background also includes business development, client acquisition, and working with financial professionals to address clients’ broader financial needs. As Vice President, Commercial Deposit Relationship Manager, Groves will work closely with commercial real estate owners, operators, and investors to provide deposit and treasury management services that support their operating needs. His role will also support the Bank’s efforts to deepen relationships with commercial real estate clients by connecting deposit and treasury services with existing and prospective lending relationships. “We are excited to welcome Blake to Northeast Bank. His experience building strong relationships and understanding the needs of commercial customers makes him an excellent addition to our team,” said Matthew Colpitts, SVP, Director of Treasury Management Services. “Blake will play an important role in expanding our deposit and treasury management relationships with commercial real estate customers, complementing the lending relationships we have built across the country. His experience and relationship-focused approach will be valuable as we continue to grow this area of our business.” About Northeast Bank Northeast Bank (NASDAQ: NBN) is headquartered in Portland, Maine and operates as both a national lender and a community bank. The Bank’s National Lending Division originates and purchases commercial real estate loans across the country. This division specializes in complex credit structures and secondary market loan acquisitions, providing tailored financing solutions to a diverse national clientele. In addition, this division includes the Bank’s Small Business segment that serves as a nationwide Small Business Administration Preferred Lender, offering government-guaranteed loans. On a regional and national level, Northeast Bank provides a comprehensive suite of depository products and cash management and treasury services through a network of seven banking centers in Maine alongside the Bank’s digital banking division, ableBanking. For more information, please visit www.northeastbank.com . articles.summary: Northeast Bank Announces Expansion into Bangor Market acoombs@northe… Tue, 09/08/2026 - 14:06 Press Release Banking Center BANGOR, Maine, (September 8, 2026) -- Northeast Bank (the “Bank”) (NASDAQ: NBN) announced plans to establish a new location in Bangor, pending final regulatory approval. The new banking center will be located in the multi-tenant retail center at 699 Broadway and is planned to open in early 2027. Northeast Bank is working with NES Group of Mansfield, Massachusetts; Studio S Architecture of Stoughton, Massachusetts; and H.E. Callahan Construction Co. of Auburn, Maine, on the development of the new banking center. The expansion represents an important investment in the greater Bangor region and reflects Northeast Bank’s continued commitment to serving individuals, businesses, municipalities, and organizations throughout Maine. The new banking center will offer competitive deposit solutions, cash management and treasury services, and relationship-based banking support to customers across the region. “As Maine’s third-largest bank, expanding into Bangor represents an exciting milestone for Northeast Bank,” said Robert Banaski, Chief Retail Banking Officer at Northeast Bank. “We look forward to becoming part of the Bangor community and bringing our competitive banking solutions and community focus to individuals and organizations throughout the region.” Additional information regarding construction progress and the opening timeline will be announced in the coming months. About Northeast Bank Northeast Bank (NASDAQ: NBN) is headquartered in Portland, Maine and operates as both a national lender and a community bank. The Bank’s National Lending Division originates and purchases commercial real estate loans across the country. This division specializes in complex credit structures and secondary market loan acquisitions, providing tailored financing solutions to a diverse national clientele. In addition, this division includes the Bank’s Small Business segment that serves as a nationwide Small Business Administration Preferred Lender offering government-guaranteed loans. On a regional and national level, Northeast Bank provides a comprehensive suite of depository products and cash management and treasury services through a network of seven banking centers in Maine alongside the Bank’s digital banking division, ableBanking. For more information, please visit www.northeastbank.com . New location at 699 Broadway extends local banking services to customers and communities in the Bangor area.
articles.title: Northeast Bank Announces Expansion into Bangor Market
